title: Multicenter evaluation of four large language models for automated spine imaging diagnosis
abstract: Accurate interpretation of spine imaging is essential for clinical decision-making, yet the diagnostic potential of large language models (LLMs) for radiological report analysis remains inadequately evaluated in terms of sample size, multi-model comparison, reproducibility, and cross-institutional generalisability. Here, we conducted a multicentre cohort study using 20,277 authentic clinical spine radiological reports from three teaching hospitals in China, systematically comparing the diagnostic performance, output consistency, and generalisability of four LLMs—GPT-4o, Claude-4, Qwen-3 Max, and DeepSeek-V3.1—across nine modality–region combinations under two input modes (with-option and without-option). All models showed high overall diagnostic performance, with specificity exceeding 90% and negative predictive value exceeding 96%. Cross-institutional validation demonstrated stable recall generalisability, with recall coefficients of variation ranging from 0.7% to 5.0%. However, performance was uneven across the disease spectrum: for low-prevalence conditions, precision declined by 19–42 percentage points, indicating a persistent long-tail diagnostic deficit. Input mode and prompt formulation also produced model-specific shifts in diagnostic behaviour. These findings suggest that LLMs may support report-based spine imaging diagnosis as clinical assistive tools, but deployment should account for disease prevalence, prompt sensitivity, and the need for domain-specific optimisation.
takeaway: 다기관 실제 판독 보고서로 4개 LLM을 비교한 결과 전반적 진단 성능은 높았지만, 저빈도 소견에서는 정밀도가 19-42%p까지 떨어지는 롱테일 문제가 확인되었다.
relevance: 우리 코호트도 No Finding이 145건(53%)으로 절반 이상을 차지하고 Nodule 7건, Fibrosis 6건, Pneumothorax 5건처럼 저빈도 소견이 다수 존재해, LLM 또는 판독 보조 모델을 적용할 경우 이런 희귀 소견에서 정밀도 저하가 유사하게 나타날 위험을 시사한다.
caveat: 대상 장기가 척추이고 우리 데이터는 흉부 X-ray이므로, 보고된 구체적 수치(특이도, 회수율)를 그대로 우리 코호트에 적용할 수는 없다.
check: 우리 코호트에서 저빈도 소견(Nodule, Fibrosis, Pneumothorax 등)에 한정해 판독 보조 도구의 정밀도가 실제로 떨어지는지 하위군 분석이 필요하다.
